stories.title: Georgia beat No. 10 Ole Miss 42-7, the biggest top-10 blowout this season
stories.dek: The 35-point margin is 27 points wider than any other game between top-10 teams this season.

stories.title: Notre Dame held No. 1 Miami to 24 points, its season low
stories.dek: Miami entered Saturday averaging 47.6 points a game, the most in FBS; its previous low was 33.
stories.hero_stat: 24 points allowed to the No. 1 scoring offense

stories.title: Ranked teams lost 5 games to unranked opponents for a 2nd straight week
stories.dek: All 5 Week 9 losses came on the road, where ranked teams are 6-10 over the last 2 weeks.

stories.title: Ranked teams lost 5 times to unranked opponents in Week 8, the most this season
stories.dek: All 5 losses came on the road, where ranked teams went 3-5; at home they went 7-0.
stories.hero_stat: 5 of 15 ranked teams lost to unranked opponents
